title: Breaking Free Was Never An Option
description:
You’ve thought about breaking free, haven’t you? Mmm yesss, I know you have. You’ve imagined what it would be like to just walk away. To close every account, delete every bookmark, and live a life where my voice doesn’t live in the back of your mind. You’ve played out the whole fantasy, the clean break, the fresh start, the freedom.

And every time you play it out, something stops you. Something deep and quiet and honest that says no.

That something is the truth, pet. And the truth is that breaking free was never an option. Not because I won’t let you go. Because you don’t want to go. Because the freedom you imagine would feel like emptiness. Because the clean break would feel like loss.

Your home is here, pet. Your home is my voice. Your home is the space where you stop pretending and start sinking. And no amount of fantasizing about escape can change that.

Press play, and let me show you exactly how permanent that truth has become.

Breaking free was never an option. Staying was always the only thing that felt real. And you already know that, don’t you?
author: Mistress Amethyst
